UNAUTHENTICATED: Authentication required. Please log in to continue.

NOT_FOUND: The requested resource was not found.

email_in_use: This email address is already registered.
invalid_token: The token provided is invalid or has expired.
session_not_found: Session not found or has already been revoked.
database_conflict: A record with this value already exists.
related_record_not_found: A related record referenced in your request was not found.

current_password_incorrect: The current password you entered is incorrect.
session_expired: Session expired or has been revoked.

forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
sod_violation: This action is blocked by the separation-of-duties rule {rule}.
scope_not_allowed: Permission {permission} cannot be granted with scope {scope}.

invalid_parameters: The parameters must be a JSON object.
user_deactivated: A deactivated user cannot be added.
group_context_role: Store or department roles are assigned to users, not to groups.

role_context_not_allowed: This role is not assigned per department or store.
store_context_unavailable: Store roles can be assigned once the Store module is available.
department_depth: Departments have two levels only: department and section.
department_in_use: The department still has active employees or sections.
employee_not_assignable: Suspended or exited employees cannot be assigned.
employee_number_in_use: This employee number is already used (numbers are never reused).
employee_not_active: The employee must be Active (or On Leave).
email_domain_not_allowed: The company email must end with an allowed domain ({domains}).
contract_end_required: Contract and intern employees need a contract end date.
invalid_date_range: The end date must be after the start date.
rehire_must_be_active: An exited employee can only return as Active (rehire).
rehire_start_date_required: A rehire needs the new start date.
acting_overlap: Another acting HOD is already set for part of this period.
user_already_active: This user has already activated the account.
cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
account_not_activated: Your account is not activated yet. Use the link sent to your company email.
account_deactivated: This account is deactivated. Contact ICT.
password_policy: The password does not meet the policy: at least {minLength} characters, letters and numbers, not a common password, not containing your name or email, and not one of your last {history} passwords.
two_factor_invalid_code: That code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
two_factor_required: Two-factor authentication is required for one of your roles and cannot be switched off.
two_factor_reset_self: You cannot reset your own two-factor authentication; ask another administrator.
two_factor_challenge_expired: The sign-in step expired. Log in again.
delegation_in_past: The delegation period has already ended.
delegate_not_active: The delegate must be an active user with an active employee record.
delegate_self: You cannot delegate to the same person.
delegate_role_not_held: Only roles the delegator holds can be delegated.
delegate_no_roles: The delegator holds no roles to delegate.
delegation_not_pending: This delegation has already been decided.
delegation_not_active: This delegation is no longer active.
import_missing_columns: The file is missing required columns: {columns}. Download the current template.
import_empty: The file has no employee rows.
import_too_large: The file has too many rows; split it into several files.
import_not_committable: Only a fully valid upload that has not been committed can be committed.
import_changed: The data changed since the preview and some rows are no longer valid. Upload the file again.
approval_not_pending: This request has already been decided.
approval_not_assigned: This approval step is not assigned to you.
approval_reason_required: A reason is required to reject or return.
approval_already_given: You have already approved this step.
step_code_duplicate: Each step needs its own code.
step_approver_missing: Choose an approver that exists for every step.
step_condition_invalid: The condition must be JSON like {"path":"amount","op":"gt","value":1000}.
step_required_count: N of M steps need the number of approvals required.
version_not_draft: Only a draft version can be activated.
clearance_not_exited: Exit clearance applies only to exited employees.
clearance_not_open: This clearance is not open for changes.
clearance_action_invalid: That action does not apply to this item.
clearance_note_required: Describe how the item was resolved.
user_awaiting_approval: The user is waiting for creation approval; the activation link is sent once approved.
report_param_required: Fill in the report's required filter.
adjustment_correction_assets: Line {line}: corrections change quantities only; assets are corrected through counts, loss or disposal.
adjustment_line_asset: Line {line}: an asset line is one unit with its details (condition, serial…).
adjustment_line_batch: Line {line}: this product is tracked by batch — enter the batch number.
adjustment_line_location: Line {line}: choose an active location of this store.
adjustment_line_product: Line {line}: the product must be Active with its store item type set.
adjustment_line_quantity: Line {line}: enter a quantity (negative quantities only for corrections).
adjustment_not_cancellable: Only adjustments waiting for approval or returned can be cancelled.
adjustment_not_postable: This adjustment is not waiting to be posted.
adjustment_not_returned: Only returned adjustments can be submitted again.
adjustment_tag_twice: Line {line}: the same tag is used twice.
adjustment_vehicle_data: Line {line}: vehicles need their registration number.
asset_not_in_store: The asset is not in the store.
asset_not_vehicle: This asset is not a vehicle.
asset_serial_in_use: This serial number is already recorded on asset {tag}.
category_code_in_use: Another category already uses this code or tag prefix.
code_format: Codes use capital letters, digits and dashes only.
file_not_found: One of the attached files was not found.
import_sheet_missing: The file has no "{sheet}" sheet. Download the current template.
location_code_in_use: This store already has a location with this code.
location_not_empty: The location still holds stock or assets.
location_not_found: Location not found in this store.
location_parent_invalid: Choose a parent location of this store that is not below this one.
location_system: System locations (receiving, rejected, in transit) cannot be changed.
product_activation_incomplete: Set the activation fields (item type, tracking, acquisition method, VAT) before the final approval.
product_asset_must_be_serialised: Fixed assets are tracked per unit (serialised).
product_code_in_use: Another product already uses this code.
product_merge_in_use: This product already has stock or assets and cannot be merged.
product_merge_same: Choose a different product to merge into.
product_merge_target_active: You can only merge into an Active product.
product_minimum_content: A product needs at least one specification and one receiving criterion before it is submitted.
product_not_editable: Only draft or returned versions can be edited.
product_not_revisable: Only Active or Inactive products can get a new version.
product_not_submittable: There is no draft or returned version to submit.
product_serialised_only_assets: Only fixed assets are serialised; use quantity or batch tracking.
product_single_source_vendor: Name the vendor for single-source products.
product_status_change: This product's status cannot be changed.
product_type_locked: Item type, tracking and vehicle flag cannot change once the product has stock or assets.
product_version_open: This product already has a version in progress.
spec_range_needs_max: A range specification needs a maximum.
stock_insufficient: Not enough available stock (stock can never go negative).
stock_levels_order: Levels must be minimum ≤ reorder ≤ maximum.
store_code_in_use: Another store already uses this code.
store_not_empty: The store still holds stock or assets.
store_one_main: There is only one main store.
tag_count: Issue between 1 and 500 tags at a time.
tag_prefix_in_use: Tags were already issued with this prefix; it cannot change.
tag_unknown: Tag {tag} was never issued by the system.
tag_used: Tag {tag} is already on an asset.
vehicle_registration_in_use: This registration number is already recorded on another vehicle.
transfer_line_asset: Line {line}: the asset must be in the sending store, in store, in good or fair condition.
transfer_line_component: Line {line}: this asset is part of kit {kit}; transfer the kit.
transfer_line_quantity: Line {line}: choose a product, location and a positive quantity.
transfer_line_available: Line {line}: only {available} available at that location.
transfer_status: This transfer is not at that stage.
transfer_receive_too_many: Line {line}: you cannot receive more than was dispatched.
transfer_dispatch_too_many: Line {line}: you cannot dispatch more than was approved.
issue_line: Line {line}: quantity products only, with a location of this store and a positive quantity.
issue_beneficiary: Choose who receives the stock (department, employee or production).
stock_count_frozen: Movements are frozen here while stock count {number} is open.
count_status: This count is not at that stage.
count_not_complete: Every line must be counted before submitting.
count_scope: Choose locations or a category for this count.
count_line: That line is not part of this count.
maintenance_status: This ticket is not at that stage.
maintenance_asset: The asset must be in the store (not reserved, out or already in maintenance).
disposal_asset: Only assets in store, damaged, missing or lost can be proposed for disposal.
disposal_status: This disposal is not at that stage.
asset_status_change: This asset cannot change to that status now.
maintenance_open: Maintenance ticket {number} is already open for this asset.
request_beneficiary: The employee must be an active member of the requesting department.
request_quantity: Enter a quantity of at least 1 (not more than requested).
request_status: This request is not at that stage.
request_plan: From store + to purchase must equal the accepted quantity ({n}).
request_delivery_product: The delivered product is not the requested product.
request_delivery_too_many: More than the accepted quantity would be delivered.
purchase_line_product: Line {line}: only your department's Active (or submitted) products.
purchase_line_internal: Line {line}: the internal request must be waiting for purchase, for the same product, with enough quantity left.
request_other_store: This request is served from another store.
clearance_custody_item: Items in custody are cleared by returning them, transferring custody, or an approved loss/damage report with a responsibility decision.
handover_request: A handover needs an approved request: an internal request for a named employee, an approved custody transfer, or a fault report (temporary replacement).
handover_request_employee: This request is for the department, not a named employee: issue it instead of handing it over.
handover_return_date: Temporary replacements need an expected return date.
handover_custodian: The custodian is not an active employee.
handover_asset: Line {line}: the asset must be in this store, in store, in good or fair condition (and part of the request).
handover_vehicle: Line {line}: vehicles are never handed over to individuals.
handover_component: Line {line}: this asset is part of a kit; hand over the kit.
handover_kit_photo: Line {line}: photos are mandatory for kits.
handover_status: This handover is not at that stage.
handover_code_invalid: The code is wrong, used or expired (15 minutes).
handover_link_invalid: This link is not valid any more (used, expired or the handover changed).
return_assets: Choose items held by one employee.
return_status: This return is not at that stage.
report_status: A responsibility decision is already pending or approved.
report_responsibility_fault: Responsibility decisions are for damage, loss or theft.
activation_link_invalid: This activation link is invalid or has expired. Ask AzamTV Procurement (or your vendor administrator) for a new one.
already_pending: A request is already waiting for approval.
amend_above_award_price: Line {line}: the price cannot be above the awarded unit price.
amend_above_award_qty: Line {line}: the quantity cannot be above the awarded quantity.
amend_below_received: Line {line}: the quantity cannot be below what was already received.
amend_new_item: An amendment cannot add items the vendor did not win.
bid_compliance_missing: Item {line}: state compliance for every specification.
bid_line_incomplete: Item {line}: enter the unit price and the delivery period.
bid_no_items: Select at least one item to bid on.
bid_not_compliant: Only a compliant offer can be chosen.
bid_not_submitted: There is no submitted bid to withdraw.
bid_validity: The bid must stay valid for at least {days} days.
cash_not_tendered: Cash purchases are recorded directly, not tendered.
clarification_deadline: The deadline for clarification questions has passed.
closing_too_soon: Set a closing time at least one hour from now.
committee_locked: The committee can no longer be changed (bids are opened).
committee_too_small: The committee needs at least {min} members.
email_taken: This email address is already used.
grn_above_outstanding: Line {line}: at most {n} can still be received.
grn_batch: Line {line}: batch number and expiry date are required.
grn_serials: Line {line}: enter exactly {n} different serial numbers.
inspection_fail_remark: Give a remark for every failed criterion and for failed quantities.
invalid_route: Choose cash, single source or quotation.
invoice_above_received: The invoices exceed the value of goods passed at inspection.
invoice_fields: Enter the vendor invoice number and date.
invoice_not_approved: The payment must be approved first.
invoice_status: This invoice cannot be sent for payment now.
justification_required: A single-source justification (at least 10 characters) is required.
letters_already_sent: The award and regret letters were already sent.
letters_not_sent: Send the award and regret letters first (standstill period).
line_not_cash: This request line is not routed to cash purchase.
line_not_open: This request line is no longer waiting for Purchasing.
line_not_ready_for_tender: Select approved lines with the same route that are not yet in a tender.
location_missing: The main store has no active {kind} location.
lpo_not_amendable: Only an issued or acknowledged LPO can be amended.
lpo_not_cancellable: This LPO cannot be cancelled (goods already received or not issued).
lpo_not_draft: Only a draft LPO can be changed or sent for issue.
lpo_not_invoiceable: Invoices can be registered only for issued LPOs.
lpo_not_issued: The LPO is not waiting for acknowledgement.
lpo_not_receivable: Goods cannot be received against this LPO in its current status.
negotiated_above_bid: A negotiated price cannot be above the quoted price.
no_eligible_vendors: No active, registered vendor supplies these categories.
no_main_store: No main store is set up.
no_single_source_vendor: The product has no single-source vendor set (Product Repository).
not_committee_member_role: {email} does not hold the committee permissions (tender.evaluate).
nothing_to_order: Every awarded item already has an LPO.
nothing_to_return: There is nothing to return to the vendor.
receive_main_store_only: Goods are received at the main store only.
request_not_approved: The purchase request is not approved.
serial_exists: Serial number {serial} is already on asset {tag}.
shop_required: Choose a vendor or enter the shop name.
single_source_one_vendor: All items of a single-source tender must have the same designated vendor.
tender_cannot_cancel: This tender can no longer be cancelled.
tender_not_awarded: The tender is not awarded yet.
tender_not_closed: Bids can be opened only after the closing time.
tender_not_draft: Only a draft tender can be changed or published.
tender_not_in_evaluation: The tender is not in evaluation.
tie_unresolved: Some items have equal lowest prices: the committee must choose, with a reason.
two_factor_not_set_up: Set up your authenticator app first.
vendor_cannot_bid: Your registration is expired or suspended: you can view tenders but not bid.
vendor_fields: Enter the name and a valid email address.
